purpose: Improve structure without changing intended behavior.
work_loop: identify preserved behavior and the reason structure should change
ensure tests or validation cover the preserved behavior
make one small structural change at a time
review the actual path for unintended behavior changes
run proof commands and read the output
done_when: structural change is smaller or clearer than status quo
failure_modes: refactor changes behavior without spec update
refactor expands scope beyond structural improvement
fallback_policy: If desired behavior changes, switch to implementation or spec route.
